headline: (With video) A-share market review: pre-holiday risk-avoidance fully released, Shanghai Composite loses 3900 points again (0924)
summary: China's A-share market fell again, with the Shanghai Composite losing the 3,900-point level before the National Day holiday. Analysts noted weak momentum and profit-taking in high-level theme stocks.
why: The Shanghai Composite tracks the broad performance of stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, a key gauge of mainland China's equity market.

impacts.name: Shanghai Composite
impacts.why: The index is the benchmark for the market where the sell-off was reported.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Risk aversion before the holiday, weak volume and profit-taking in high-level theme stocks pushed the index lower.
